title: Depth and edge preprocessors: Sobel by hand
hook: Compute Sobel by hand, see why Canny blurs first and what its thresholds are measured in, and learn how a depth map becomes a grey hint.

verified.claim: The Canny node passes the image to kornia.filters.canny with defaults 0.4 and 0.8.
The stencil, the step response and noise tables come from the lab.
v2_style uses percentiles, though the tooltip says mean/std.
kornia 0.9.0 is the version installed on our test machine and the docs we read.
d_canny_preview and nm_mask_canny ran on a CPU here.

unchecked: The disc test is one toy shape with Gaussian noise and a plain threshold, not the full Canny node.
We don't state which depth convention any one ControlNet was trained on: see CU-272.
Another kornia version could scale the gradient differently.
